sources.finding: POWER states typical meteorological latency of 2-3 days and solar latency of 5-7 days; it directs users to current service status for actual latency.
sources.inference: Observation dates alone cannot verify that predictors were published by the forecast date. Seven days is a proposed future daily-data planning buffer, not a guarantee or verification of monthly/historical release vintages.

sources.status: Author paper abstract opened and read
sources.finding: De Clercq and Mahdi study district-level Kharif rice yields with climate and satellite predictors over 20 years and 247 districts; the abstract discusses temperature, soil water and leaf area index.
sources.inference: Supports testing season-aligned weather and crop-state predictors. Its reported scores are not comparable project guarantees or proof that our inputs have adequate spatial/temporal linkage.
